steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: Guard this place.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: Watch your formation, keep an eye on her movements.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: You know who it is we're facing. Don't be like those stupid mercs.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: ...Here she comes.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: Watch her hands.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: She could draw her sword at any—

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: Watch the lights and shadows. Don't try to follow the sword.
The Sarkaz with white horns silently carries her sword in her arms.
Wordlessly, she keeps moving forward.
The guards instinctively step back.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: Hold your ground!
She stops.
Under the gaze of the guards, she raises her left hand, and takes out a small piece of paper from within her tattered robe.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: I came as appointed, as he wished. No need to be on guard.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Which way to Riverbank Street?
Shining!
What are you doing standing there? Get out of the way! I told you we had a family meeting today.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: Understood.
What took you so long, Shining? I've been waiting!

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: ...Salus.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: It's not time yet.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: No, it's not. The leader won't be angry.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: Come in, dinner's ready. Look at you. Have you not had anything decent to eat since you left Londinium?

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: I've talked to the leader. Tonight's menu is being prepared to Royal Victorian Academy of Sciences banquet standards.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: Oh, Shining, Shining! How long has it been since the old days, when we used to chat at the dinner table? Tell me what you've seen and heard!

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: Leader, Shining's back!

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Welcome.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Sit. This is your place. We just came to Londinium then... it was a long time ago.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: It has been empty ever since you killed those poor souls and fled with the test subject.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: That betrayal chilled the clan to the bone.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: But I don't blame you. Sit.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: I can't wait. I've hardly had a good meal lately, staying all night in the labs.
She pulls a chair and sits by the right hand side of the white-horned Confessarius leader.
He stops speaking and sits with his eyes half-closed.
A moment later, Shining puts down her sword and walks toward the only chair that is empty by the long table.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Talk about your experiments, Salus.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: Work at the dinner table? Alright, alright.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: There isn't much to talk about. I'm doing my best to extract emotions from memories, but the voices of the dead don't linger long on my fingertips.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: I've gotten some results, but only fragments. I'm running into a bottleneck.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: The information is like branches cut from their tree. You can reconstruct the shape of the tree, but a tree can't survive without its roots, much less grow new sprouts.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: And I can't capture voices from further before, never mind bringing them back to the present.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: Like time, life only goes in one direction. A description of its nature must necessarily be abstract and literary. Even the Originium Arts of you and Shining can only capture an instant.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: The King of Sarkaz is the exception.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: That knowledge and the technique are like a waterfall, yet we can never find its source, or draw fresh water from it.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: My research has stalled since Shining's experiments stopped.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: What about you, Leader? Is the Regent planning something big? You've been spending most of your time at Westhaleg or The Shard; you hardly come to my lab anymore.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: The Regent's plan is at a crucial stage.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: I'm not sure I understand.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: From Kazdel to Kazdel, the Confessarii's service to those in power has always been one of pure mutual gain.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: But you've been so close to the Regent that people on the outside are beginning to think the Confessarius is the Regent's lieutenant.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Since when have we cared, Salus?

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: This is hardly the first time they've misunderstood the Confessarii.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: What's different about Theresis?

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: I would not recommend saying that name within earshot of General Manfred.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: That's why I'm doing it in front of family.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: Like his predecessor, he came from no royal court, and his bloodline is far less pure than yours or Shining's.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: None of their ancestors have ever caught the Confessarii's attention. We've never gathered memories from their bloodlines.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: Even if the King of Sarkaz chose his sister, it does not mean that her brother...

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Just as I've told you, Salus.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Power comes from blood. Blood inherits memory. Memory accumulates sin. Sin forms shackles. Only those unbound by history can truly unshackle power.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: Alright, alright. May the glory of old return to the land under their majestic guidance.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: No, Salus.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Succeed or fail, the Regent will make an impact on the Sarkaz. This is what is most frequently ignored.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: By the way, the test subject you took... what's her name again? Lisa? Liz? How's she doing?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: ...Liz is doing fine.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: Is Oripathy taking its toll on her?

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: She is... unusual. Even if Dame Kal'tsit is at... at... at that medical institution you found, they may not be able to truly help her.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: It's good that she's back in Londinium. Your lab's still here with everything. You can bring her back anytime.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Is the food not to your taste, my dear sister?

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: It's been such a long time since you've been home. Speak up.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: If this is about Liz... I apologize. But you know Liz is not your average Infected.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: Who's responsible for her suffering and consciousness? Who's responsible for her pain and memories? Can you continue to get along after she remembers all that?

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: She's not family. You have to—

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: —She's my family.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: But... but she's going to become an empty shell if you don't come back to us. Don't forget why she was built that way.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: If you really care for her, I hope the end won't be too painful. Come back.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: I'm sure you understand.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: You understand. That's why you answered my invitation, isn't it?

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: From Originium to the truth of the King of Sarkaz. We've reached a clearer conclusion.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: She's simply an old cage. We could build a new one, if we had to...

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Enough.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: Sigh.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: I've never seen you really angry, even when you hurt your own colleagues and took the girl.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: I guess I don't need to ask what you went through, all these years. What I can see is that...

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: You see outsiders as more important than family.
Salus empties her cup, which contained only water.
There was no wine. She does not like drinking, especially at work.
Her shadow sways under the light. This was not supposed to be a work day.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: You're not my family.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Haven't I made that clear enough?

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: You have.
Shining does not look at the untouched food, or the other two Confessarii by her side.
She simply stands up, holding her sword in her arms.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: I've asked the men watching Liz to leave.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: There's no need to send me any more invitations.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: The next time we meet... I expect it'll be in battle.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: 'Asked them to leave.'

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: Shining... you really think you're going to just leave like this?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: There's nothing left for us to talk about.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: What if I said I don't want you to leave?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: You can't stop me.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: I think I can make you stay and chat for a little longer.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: No?
The leader of the Confessarii silently sips his wine.
Shining can feel Salus activate her Arts. She could leave by pulling her sword, but what would happen then?
Will that really help her save Liz?

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Shining.

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: Leader! I wasn't really about to use force against Shining. Why did you stop me?

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: I've allowed you to act on your own.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: I've allowed you to be absent from my side.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: But do not interfere with the Regent's plans. Do not hinder the Sarkaz path to our long-awaited future.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Shining, my sister.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: No one can truly break free from her bloodline, no matter how much she might detest it, how much she might desire to break those shackles.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: It is meaningless to try to deny the gift of blood.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: ...I thought you already knew.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Not everything will go according to your plan...

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Father.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: ...Your Highness.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: My, my, Lettou. Why such a frown on your face?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Is the wine not good enough for you? Or is the flavor of the food too light?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Good wine should be paired with the futile resistance of the weak against fate, and the arrogance of heroes who drown in prophecy.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Even I am amazed at how they write their own stories for their own entertainment. Unfortunately, our Victorian friends are too reliant on fiction.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: We've seen better stuff, have we not, Lettou?

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: I just saw you feed a nobleman's wife and children to your troops.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: I support the vetting of potential insurgents, but...

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Ugh––!

a.text: His voice dies in his throat.
It is as though all the blood in his body has been forced to his esophagus. He falls to his knees and opens his mouth in desperation, but cannot find any air.
A blood mist comes over his vision. He sees the Vampire still sitting in his place, elegant and calm, not even bothering to look at him.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Lt. Colonel!

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Form up! Protect the commander!

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: You'll fight me here?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: That's not what the taste of your blood tells me.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Fear... worry.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: They're screaming for you to back off, to run away.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: ...Hold the line!
The lips of the soldiers are as pale as their faces.
They hold their weapons with trembling hands—sabers, bows, what Victoria has made for them.
They are the finest soldiers, unafraid of the Streltsy of Ursus, the Arts of Leithanien, or the broadside guns of Columbia.
But they are afraid of the Sarkaz sitting before them.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Put down your weapons...

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Stand... stand down...

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Lt. Colonel...

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: This is an order...

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Yes... sir.
The soldiers back off in an orderly manner.
It took all of Lettou's strength to give the order. He stops resisting and accepts the eternal darkness that the Sarkaz has prepared for him.
Then, he hears the silky voice again.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Lettou, Lettou.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: I thought we were friends. Friends should trust each other, shouldn't they?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: I think I've been kind, overlooking those little extra-curricular activities of you and your men.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Deals under the table, black markets in the alleys... I've turned a blind eye to them because I don't think greed and desire should be punished.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: But I expect the same trust in return.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Many Gaulish nobles keep fowlbeasts as pets, building jeweled cages for the adorable things, lying them down on soft and delicate cushions.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: All the fowlbeasts need to do is squawk, and they'll be served the finest food.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: When the fowlbeasts are in a bad mood and peck their masters, their masters eagerly tell people of the intelligence and personality of their fowlbeasts.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: But do you think the fowlbeasts have tamed their masters?
Air returns to Lettou's lungs.
It takes him some time to stand again, his limbs still trembling, but he does his best to keep that trembling out of his voice.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Thank you for your mercy, Your Highness.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: March! March!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Stay in line!

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I heard you were looking for me.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: How are your injuries?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Same as ever. Won't interfere with the mission.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I just got a message. Here.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Let me see.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Lost contact with the mercs sent to Highbury?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: They should have been in communication an hour ago.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: The Military Commission is dissatisfied with the recent performance of the mercenaries.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Soldiers must pay attention to a greater battlefield. The Regent and I had... high hopes... for the mercenaries.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I'll find out what happened to them.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: No need. I've made arrangements.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: There's a possibility that they ran into an old acquaintance of yours.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Who could be as concerned about the Sarkaz supply lines as we ourselves?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Let me guess, Dr. {@nickname} and Ascalon...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Are they investigating the Highbury munitions factories, or are they already preparing to attack other hubs with information about the supply lines?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Tend to your injuries, mercenary.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You don't need any more 'wounds' before I find your old friends, one by one.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Doctor! You're here!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Did you get the intel from the factory?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Not bad. I was thinking what I would have to do to extract you and Feist if something went wrong.

options: Can I ask you another favor, Ascalon?

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: She operates on her own devices.

options: The Sarkaz mercenary who wouldn't hurt the worker...

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: ...W will know.
Doctor!
You turn around at the voice.
You see a familiar sight coming towards you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We're here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes... same here...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: When you suggested that we split up a few days ago, I knew it was the right call, but...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: At least we came back together alright. I'm so happy about that.

options: Closure is key to tomorrow's operation.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Don't worry, I'm pretty well-prepared over here.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I don't know if the defenses share the same weaknesses across Londinium, but there must be common characteristics to the framework.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I've updated the drone's intrusion program based on intel from Misery and Horn, as well as the data taken from the artillery control room.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Get the drone close to the core of the Defense Force's command tower, and I can break into the system and access traffic records from the past ten days within thirty minutes.

options: Can you do it in twenty?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yeah... tomorrow will be a hard day.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We've been probing the responses of the Sarkaz army within Londinium in the last few days.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We expect Manfred and the Vampire to show up quickly. Ascalon, Logos and I will do our best to delay them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: However...

options: The longer it takes, the more dangerous it is.
We can't give Theresis time to react.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: The Sarkaz of the Royal Court could appear at any time.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit is helping us delay the Nachzehrer and Lich, but there's only so much time she can buy.

options: We can't handle multiple members of the Royal Court at once.
It could be very disadvantageous for us.
Watch the signal and be ready to pull out at a moment's notice.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island and the Self-Salvation Corps are ready.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Allerdale, the mercenaries are looking for you.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Sorry, I was distracted. What did you say?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: No, I'm the one who should apologize.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Maybe we could have saved Ailshie together, if I wasn't so anxious to leave.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I know she's important to you.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: She's my only family.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: House Cumberland is no more.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: One woman does not make a family, eh?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Maybe it was something that should have happened a long time ago, delayed until today.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Don't say that, Allerdale.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: That Vampire will be made to pay, I promise.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: The steam armor was lost in the fire. Maybe that's for the better. That way, I won't have to see it anymore.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: ...Vina.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Can you take me to the Glasgow Gang? I can pretend nothing ever happened.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I carry nothing on my shoulders. I'll just be your brain trust.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Sorry... I forgot you had Morgan.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I'll just be a thug then.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: We'll bomb the Sarkaz camp together. You light a fire, and I'll kick their commander's arse once there's smoke.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I'm joking.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: My path is long determined, Vina.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Why do you say that? You're still with us. The Glasgow Gang has more stories to write.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: So...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The answer is yes.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I'll make sure you come back unharmed after kicking that commander's arse.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: That's my promise.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I see... thanks.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Let's leave the jokes at that. I would begin to believe them if this went on.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Alright, I've got to go. Totter and the mercenaries are waiting for me. We need to double-check our route.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Get ready, Vina.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: The Sighs of Kings is before us.
Would you have said yes, if she truly invited you to leave?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Clovisia?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: The walls of Londinium are tall. Few are able to escape their shadow.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: But you did. You escaped the palace, and escaped Londinium. Perhaps Allerdale envies you because of that.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: She has forced herself to carry the Cumberland name for twenty years.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: But you're different. You thought about leaving your name behind, didn't you?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: ...I can't deny that.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: But I'm here now, regardless of what I thought.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Victoria is on the brink right now, and I must fight for her.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: ...Victoria.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Kings, nobles, merchants, soldiers, workers...

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: People often use the word 'Victoria' to justify their actions, but it has done nothing to quell the endless conflict over the centuries.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Who defines what Victoria is? Is it the sixty nomadic cities and the land around them, the forty million people that live within, or the monarch who rules them?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Your Royal Highness Alexandrina Vina Victoria.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Why have you come back, when you say you came back for Victoria?

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: The noble mansions have been burned to the ground. Wonder how many survivors there are...

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: The Sarkaz are planning something big, and the Defense Forces aren't trying to hide it anymore.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: This street may never be the same again.
Golding knows that the visit from the commander means her identity is no longer a secret.
She wanders the streets aimlessly, filled with a deep feeling of helplessness.
Perhaps it was always futile for humans to fight the tide.
Adams's bookstore is open, but the familiar warm, yellow light is absent. Golding has a bad feeling.
The bookstore is empty, but the smell of blood fills every corner, so thick it might as well have taken physical form.
Golding realizes that the ground is sticky.
Not just the ground. The counter, the cashier, the books on the shelves, and the teapot that Adams always has by his side.
Everything has been painted a shade of light red.
Blood.
The nausea that has been bothering Golding for days explodes uncontrollably.
She runs out onto the streets and begins to vomit.
Are you okay?

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: Ugh—*cough*

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: ...Molly.

steps.name: Molly
steps.text: You don't look well. Here, take my shoulder.

steps.name: Molly
steps.text: We still have time, Lady Golding. Your part is not over yet.

steps.name: Molly
steps.text: You said that education was your strength, didn't you?

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: My strength...

steps.name: Molly
steps.text: Let's go back.

steps.name: Molly
steps.text: We've persevered for so long. We'll see this to the end.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I'm counting on you.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Don't worry, we'll get our new friends to the base safely.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: You're not coming with us?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I have another mission.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Your grandson is a pretty big deal in the Corps, after all.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Real big deals don't usually boast about it.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Oh, and I have to return this, Granny.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Your badge.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I'm not a worker anymore. I shouldn't be wearing this outside.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Being smart isn't enough to fool death. Those who are gone will never come back, and the wounds left behind do not necessarily fade with time.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: But I don't want to spend night after night in regret, staring at machines with no one to use them.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Because...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I will go into each and every night.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I will carry the torch left behind by those who are gone and keep walking.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Until the cold is driven out, and the path ahead is no longer dark. And even then, I'll keep walking.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Not for some ethereal hope, not because I'm still waiting for someone to make a stand for us.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: You said it, that we built Londinium with our own hands.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Even if the city is reduced to rubble tomorrow, we'll start rebuilding it the day after.
Feist says all that in one breath.
His words are met with silence, but he finds that the silence no longer makes him anxious.
A thought comes mind as he gazes upon his grandmother, standing by the production line.
When did her hair turn so white?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Huff...

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Go, if your mind's made up.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Let me see.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Bye, Granny.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Feist!
Feist glimpses a small card flying towards him from the corner of his eye.
It is the badge that he just returned.
He smiles.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I'll be back, Granny.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: With victory.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I know you'll be proud of me, so there's no need to say it.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: What I really want you to know is...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I'll be proud of this factory, no matter where I go in the future.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: And... you too.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Also, I've thought about the question you asked.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: The things that disappointed you so much, the betrayal, the suspicions, people who just can't work together... I know we'll have to face them again.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: But if knowing that means we have to abandon our trust in others... then we won't survive this war.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We have to face it sooner or later, win or lose.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: One more thing.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I've never seen inside the suit of a Steam Knight, but I'll always remember the silhouette hammering away by the production line.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: You've always been my hero, and you always will be.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Hehe...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Bye, for real, before this gets too awkward.
Bang. Clang. Bang.
The production line keeps running, as though nothing has ever changed.
Feist hears a familiar sigh from deep inside the factory.
He waves without looking back, and walks into the sunlight outside.
